note: Primary sources for this watch cycle. Press and podcasts are not evidence. Authors were corrected in round 2 against Crossref/arXiv metadata.

sources.title: Neuronal wiring diagram of an adult brain
sources.authors: Dorkenwald, Matsliah, Sterling, Schlegel, Yu, McKellar et al. (FlyWire Consortium); Seung, Murthy
sources.claim_used: FlyWire whole-brain reconstruction exists (139255 neurons, ~5e7 synapses). Wiring is a resource, not a coordination proof.

sources.title: Network statistics of the whole-brain connectome of Drosophila
sources.authors: Lin, Yang, Dorkenwald, Matsliah, Sterling, Schlegel et al.
sources.claim_used: Rich-club ~30% of neurons (degree cutoff 37); 676 broadcasters and 638 integrators under an arbitrary 5x in/out rule; reciprocity 0.138; mean directed path 4.42 in giant SCC; NPC null model accounts for rich-club excess via interneuropil connections.
sources.claim_locator: results: The fly brain has a large rich club; Recurrent motifs are over-represented

sources.title: Distributed control circuits across a brain-and-cord connectome
sources.authors: Bates, Phelps, Kim, Yang et al.
sources.claim_used: Local sensor-effector loops dominate; AN/DN long-range circuits form behavior-centric modules; higher regions supervise; authors analogize to subsumption / distributed robotic control.
sources.claim_locator: abstract; section Interactions among behaviour modules (subsumption)

sources.title: Building compositional tasks with shared neural subspaces
sources.authors: Tafazoli, Bouchacourt, Ardalan, Markov, Uchimura, Mattar, Daw, Buschman
sources.claim_used: Macaque PFC reuses shared subspaces across compositionally related tasks and quiets unused ones. Press name Cognitive Legos is not a source.

sources.title: Learning expectations shape cognitive control allocation
sources.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
sources.claim_used: Humans allocate more cognitive control when they expect a task to be learnable, forgoing short-run reward.

sources.title: Capable language models can outgrow the benefits of collaboration
sources.authors: Kim, Gu, Park, Park, Schmidgall, Heydari et al.
sources.claim_used: Equal-budget MAS study: single-agent baseline predicts whether extra agents help; ~45% capability-saturation selection rule; sequential MAS regressions 39-70%; independent error amplification 17.2x vs centralized 4.4x.

sources.title: A brain-inspired agentic architecture to improve planning with LLMs
sources.claim_used: MAP implements PFC-inspired functions as LLM prompt modules plus orchestration. Negative example: cognition spent on coordination.

sources.title: EvoAgent: Towards Automatic Multi-Agent Generation via Evolutionary Algorithms
sources.authors: Yuan, Song, Chen, Tan, Li, Yang
sources.claim_used: MAS configurations can be mutated/crossed. Not a warrant to run Queen now.

sources.title: EvoMAS: Evolutionary Generation of Multi-Agent Systems
sources.authors: Hu, Zhang, Trager, Zhang, Yang, Xia, Soatto
sources.claim_used: Evolves topology/prompts/tools with an LLM meta-model and LLM-judge reward. Do not copy the operator into MeshyAnts core experiments.

sources.title: Exploring the Role of the Rich Club in Network Control of Neurocognitive States
sources.claim_used: Prohibiting peripheral controllers hurts more than prohibiting the rich club. Rich club fits a passive data-highway role, not a control center.

sources.title: Selection of the fittest or selection of the luckiest: the emergence of Goodhart's law in evolution
sources.claim_used: Too-strong selection on a noisy phenotypic proxy favors luck over heritable fitness.

sources.title: Goodhart's Law in Reinforcement Learning
sources.authors: Karwowski, Hayman, Bai, Kiendlhofer, Griffin, Skalse
sources.claim_used: Optimising an imperfect proxy past a point decreases true objective. Relevant to Queen fitness design.

sources.title: Ant Colony Optimization
sources.claim_used: Pheromone trace without a local heuristic (beta->0) collapses. Decay is a design invariant, not flavor.
sources.claim_locator: monograph; cited as classic, not a 2024-26 result

rejected_as_evidence.title: Cognitive Legos help the brain build complex behaviors
rejected_as_evidence.reason: Princeton/EurekAlert press name for S4. Lead only.

rejected_as_evidence.title: Brain Inspired interviews/transcripts
rejected_as_evidence.reason: Listed on the task as a discovery source. No claim in this watch rests on a transcript.

rejected_as_evidence.title: BIGMAS (arXiv:2603.15371)
rejected_as_evidence.reason: Central workspace + Orchestrator. Rejected as a MeshyAnts pattern.

rejected_as_evidence.title: DeLM (arXiv:2606.10662)
rejected_as_evidence.reason: Interesting decentralized MAS lead; not NeuroAI evidence.
